purpose: Isolated C# CPU and GTX 1050 experiments using the same ten Turkish-English sentences; not an application integration or a release.
root: Research/OfflineTranslation, relative to the repository root
hardware: Intel Core i5-8300H, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 4 GB, driver 582.66; DXGI adapter index 1

dependencies.onnxRuntimeNative: 1.31.1, existing Microsoft Windows x64 DLLs extracted from onnxruntime-node under Runtimes/Onnx/node_modules/onnxruntime-node/bin/napi-v6/win32/x64
dependencies.tokenizers: 3.0.0-preview.26513.4; public in-memory Unigram factory avoids the protobuf factory's negative-BOS issue without modifying the library
dependencies.csWin32: 0.3.363, used for typed DXGI adapter enumeration

inputs.toz: Models/Toz/encoder_q8.onnx, decoder_q8.onnx and tokenizer.model, from https://huggingface.co/TozAI/Toz-Cevir-1
inputs.bergamot: The original binary models and vocabularies under Models/Mozilla/tr-en and en-tr, from Mozilla's translations-models Remote Settings collection

timing: First pass retained separately; second pass timed after warmup. CPU and GPU compared sequentially with the same files, C# decoding and beam=4. Profiling is enabled only by --probe and disabled for timed runs.
validation: C# Bergamot token IDs matched Google SentencePiece on all ten inputs. Runtime profiles confirm DML execution on the NVIDIA adapter. CPU helpers remain in Toz; the Bergamot GPU probe has DML node events only.
knownDifference: The custom Bergamot float32 path is experimental and is not output-equivalent to the original quantized runtime: the tr05 negation is lost on both CPU and GPU. Results record this difference; no application integration was performed.
